name: Sensor Tower
description: Sensor Tower's MCP Server makes it simple for your team to turn data into insights using Claude. Easily access app Downloads, Revenue, Active Users, Ad Spend, and Impressions, and browse ad creatives from brands and retailers across categories. Ask natural language questions like "Which apps are growing DAUs with WoW growth above 10% among the top five travel apps?" or "What are the top creatives in CPG capturing the largest share of voice?" — and get fast, accurate answers using the tools you already work in.  Arm your Marketing, Data Analysis, M&A, and Strategy teams with direct, flexible access to the data they need to make faster, smarter decisions.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Sensor Tower to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Sensor Tower to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.sensortower.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Sensor Tower MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Sensor Tower lists 24 MCP tools, including get_app_annotations, get_app_creatives, get_app_demographics, get_app_details, get_app_download_channels, get_app_impression_share, get_app_market_size, get_app_performance_metrics, get_app_ratings, get_app_retention, get_app_review_analytics, and get_app_store_chart_rankings.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Sensor Tower?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Sensor Tower in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.

_published_faq.name: Does Sensor Tower MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Sensor Tower requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Sensor Tower is developed by Sensor Tower. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
